name: HubSpot Support Ticket Frustration Slack Escalation (dhRobin Systems)

parameters.content:
## n8n-hubspot-support-ticket-frustration-slack-escalation
**dhRobin Systems** · HubSpot ticket replies (webhook, 10-min poll, or fixture) → conversation thread messages → keep genuine customer messages only (no agent notes, agent replies, auto-replies, bounces, internal senders) → frustration score 0–100 + sentiment regression → cooldown → Slack Block Kit escalation → optional HubSpot flag → audit.

**Safe by default.** With no environment variables set:
- `SANDBOX_MODE=true`: synthetic tickets. **Zero HubSpot or Slack calls.**
- `DRY_RUN=true`, `SEND_SLACK_ALERTS=false`, `WRITE_TO_HUBSPOT=false`.

### Scoring
Legal 45 · churn 32 · escalation 22 · frustration 20 · repetition 16 · urgency 10 (+3 per extra hit), negation-aware.
+ exclamation runs, ALL-CAPS ratio, unanswered follow-ups; − positive language (never offsets legal/churn).
Tiers: critical ≥ 80 or any legal signal · high ≥ 60 · moderate ≥ 35.
Escalate at ≥ `ESCALATE_MIN_TIER`, or on regression (Δ ≥ 20) at moderate+.

### Pinned synthetic payloads
Pinned: webhook, ticket search, thread lookup + messages (2 tickets), ticket / association / company / contact reads, Slack (2 alerts), ticket flags, run summary.
Pins apply to **manual executions only**. Unpin a node before a manual live test.

nodes.name: Ticket Reply Webhook
nodes.notes: HubSpot app webhooks (conversation.newMessage, ticket.*) or a workflow webhook { ticketId }.

nodes.name: Polling Fallback Schedule
nodes.notes: Every 10 minutes: tickets modified within POLL_LOOKBACK_MINUTES.

assignments.name: config.keywordWeights
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { try { const j = JSON.parse(String($env.KEYWORD_WEIGHTS ?? '{}') || '{}'); return j && typeof j === 'object' && !Array.isArray(j) ? j : {}; } catch (e) { return {}; } })() }}

nodes.name: Config & Safety Gate
nodes.notes: Typed, non-secret configuration under config.*. Flags record only whether a secret or URL is set.

nodes.name: Parse & Verify Webhook Events
nodes.notes: v3 signature, event types, loop guard, de-duplication.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ filterGroups: [{ filters: [{ propertyName: $('Config & Safety Gate').first().json.config.pollDateProperty || 'hs_lastmodifieddate', operator: 'GTE', value: String(Date.now() - $('Config & Safety Gate').first().json.config.pollLookbackMinutes * 60000) }].concat($('Config & Safety Gate').first().json.config.closedStageIds.length ? [{ propertyName: 'hs_pipeline_stage', operator: 'NOT_IN', values: $('Config & Safety Gate').first().json.config.closedStageIds }] : []) }], sorts: [{ propertyName: $('Config & Safety Gate').first().json.config.pollDateProperty || 'hs_lastmodifieddate', direction: 'DESCENDING' }], properties: ['hs_object_id'], limit: Math.min(100, $('Config & Safety Gate').first().json.config.maxTicketsPerRun) }) }}

nodes.name: HubSpot: Find Thread
nodes.notes: Thread by ID, or threads by associatedTicketId. Scope: conversations.read.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Get Thread Messages
nodes.notes: Up to 100 messages per thread. Scope: conversations.read.

nodes.name: Sentiment Regression & Frustration Scoring
nodes.notes: Customer-message filter, score 0–100, tier, regression, should_escalate.

nodes.name: Cooldown & Escalation Gate
nodes.notes: Per-ticket cooldown (property + memory), tier break-through, per-run cap.

nodes.name: Build Slack Escalation Alerts
nodes.notes: Block Kit alerts with redacted preview + HubSpot link.
